faq.title: FAQ
faq.description: Key notes about uploads, diagnosis, rewriting, and privacy.

items.question: Will it invent my experience?
items.answer: No. ResumeFit AI is designed to preserve facts. Any inferred metric, scope, or outcome is placed in a facts-to-confirm list.

items.question: Can I use it without a full JD?
items.answer: Yes. You can enter a role direction such as AI Product Manager or Growth Marketing. A full JD makes the diagnosis more specific.

items.question: Which formats are supported?
items.answer: V1 supports PDF, DOCX, image, and text. Text PDFs and DOCX files can be extracted directly; scanned PDFs and images use recognition or pasted text fallback.

items.question: Are uploads used for training?
items.answer: No. V1 processes resume and JD content only for the current request, does not store raw content, and does not use uploads for training.
